GRDP.description: Group Damping (GRDP). A single global record (key is always 1) holding default Rayleigh/damping settings plus per-group damping coefficients (GROUP_DAMPING_ITEMS) and per-group strain-energy damping ratios (STRAIN_GROUP_ITEMS); each item's GROUP_TYPE selects how its GROUP_NAME is interpreted.

STIFF_COEF_DEFAULT.description: Stiffness proportional coefficient for unspecified nodes/elements/boundaries. Direct Specification: user input; Calculate from Modal Damping: auto-calculated.

MASS_COEF_DEFAULT.description: Mass proportional coefficient for unspecified nodes/elements/boundaries. Direct Specification: user input; Calculate from Modal Damping: auto-calculated.

OPT_CALC_WHEN_USED.description: Calculate only when used flag for the default group-damping data.

OPT_MASS_PROP_DEFAULT.description: Mass proportional option for the default (unspecified) group-damping data.

OPT_STIFF_PROP_DEFAULT.description: Stiffness proportional option for the default (unspecified) group-damping data.

DIRECT_CALC_MODE_DEFAULT.description: Default coefficient source. Direct Specification: 0; Calculate from Modal Damping: 1.

FREQ_PERIOD_MODE_DEFAULT.description: Default coefficient calculation basis. Frequency: 0; Period: 1.

FREQ_MODE_1_DEFAULT.description: Default frequency for mode 1 (used when FREQ_PERIOD_MODE_DEFAULT = 0).

FREQ_MODE_2_DEFAULT.description: Default frequency for mode 2 (used when FREQ_PERIOD_MODE_DEFAULT = 0).

PERIOD_MODE_1_DEFAULT.description: Default period for mode 1 (used when FREQ_PERIOD_MODE_DEFAULT = 1).

PERIOD_MODE_2_DEFAULT.description: Default period for mode 2 (used when FREQ_PERIOD_MODE_DEFAULT = 1).

bExistElement.description: Whether element mass & stiffness proportional group damping data exists (GROUP_DAMPING_ITEMS is active).

bExistStrain.description: Whether strain-energy proportional group damping data exists (STRAIN_GROUP_ITEMS is active).

GROUP_DAMPING_ITEMS.description: Mass & stiffness proportional damping coefficients for specified material data / structure groups / boundary groups.

GROUP_TYPE.description: Target type (case-insensitive). STRUCTURE: structure group; BOUNDARY: boundary group; MATERIAL: material data. Determines how GROUP_NAME is interpreted.

GROUP_NAME.description: [GROUP_TYPE=STRUCTURE] structure group name; [GROUP_TYPE=BOUNDARY] boundary group name; [GROUP_TYPE=MATERIAL] material ID as a numeric string.

STIFF_COEF.description: Stiffness proportional coefficient for this group.

OPT_STIFF_PROP.description: Stiffness proportional option for this group.

MASS_COEF.description: Mass proportional coefficient for this group.

OPT_MASS_PROP.description: Mass proportional option for this group.

DIRECT_CALC_MODE.description: Coefficient source. Direct Specification: 0; Calculate from Modal Damping: 1.

DAMPING_RATIO_MODE.description: Damping ratio source. Using Material Data: 0; Direct Define: 1.

STRAIN_GROUP_ITEMS.description: Strain-energy proportional damping ratios for specified elements and boundaries, per material data / structure group / boundary group.

GROUP_TYPE.description: Target type (case-insensitive). STRUCTURE: structure group; BOUNDARY: boundary group; MATERIAL: material data. Determines how GROUP_NAME is interpreted.

GROUP_NAME.description: [GROUP_TYPE=STRUCTURE] structure group name; [GROUP_TYPE=BOUNDARY] boundary group name; [GROUP_TYPE=MATERIAL] material ID as a numeric string.

DAMPING_RATIO.description: Strain-energy proportional damping ratio for this group.

ELEM_GROUP_PRIORITY.description: Element damping priority between material data and structure group. Material Data: 0; Structure Group: 1.

ELEM_VALUE_PRIORITY.description: Element damping priority between overlapping structure groups. Smallest Damping Ratio: 0; Largest Damping Ratio: 1.

STRAIN_GROUP_PRIORITY.description: Strain-energy damping priority between material data and structure group. Material Data: 0; Structure Group: 1.

STRAIN_VALUE_PRIORITY.description: Strain-energy damping priority between overlapping structure groups. Smallest Damping Ratio: 0; Largest Damping Ratio: 1.
